authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9661 bhrātṛ explicitly gives bhāi/bhāu brother, older/younger local distinctions, and Palula brhō. The survey bhāyo/bhaiyā/bro forms fit this kinship family, preserving the source age distinctions. Exact survey form bʰaīyā is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13479 supta explicitly gives Maithili sūtab sleep, Old Marwari sūto asleep and Palula suttu past slept. These t-bearing sleep forms select the participial family; initial-h forms require a local correspondence check. Exact survey form sūtab is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
